answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 41285 Country: India Title: I have a 3 year old daughter, I kept her name as Daania. Please tell whether this name is correct. Please suggest some good names if it is not correct. Question: I have a 3 year old daughter, I kept her name as Daania. Please tell whether this name is correct. Please suggest some good names if it is not correct. Answer ID: 41285 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 863/869/N=1433) Daania name is correct. It means: close at hand. It is mentioned in the holy Quran regarding the fruits of Jannah: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ [الحاقة : 23] The fruits of which will be close at hand. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
